title: How well teachers teach English in classrooms that include Black queer youth will depend largely on how willing they are to know all of their students
summary: How well teachers teach English in classrooms that include Black queer youth will depend largely on how willing they are to know all of their students. When teachers invite students to compose themselves in ways that enact their queer identities, we liberate voices that are normally silenced Latrise Johnson #quote
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
How well teachers teach English in classrooms that include Black queer youth will depend largely on how willing they are to know all of their students. When teachers invite students to compose themselves in ways that enact their queer identities, we liberate voices that are normally silenced
Latrise Johnson
#quote
